data_description.dataset_name: Global Mangrove Watch v3 Change Raster (1996 baseline)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global mangrove change rasters referenced to a fixed 1996 baseline, with one image for each target year represented in the collection.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Change layers comparing a 1996 baseline against target years 2007-2020 (derived from `system:index` values like `gmw_v3_f1996_t2007`).
data_description.temporal_unit: Per target year change layer relative to the 1996 baseline

raster_content.thematic_group: Global Land Use and Land Cover

band_semantics.b1: Mangrove-change raster comparing baseline year 1996 to the target year encoded by `system:index`.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The runtime index indicates a fixed 1996 baseline compared against later target years, not a simple timestamped annual stack.
analytical_capabilities: Combination with shoreline or storm-surge datasets

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Mangrove change class codes relative to the 1996 baseline; class meanings should be verified from the source docs before tabulation.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the target year encoded in `system:index` and do not interpret the collection as a regular annual time series starting in 1996.

data_description.data_source: Global Mangrove Watch, Aberystwyth University, solo Earth Observation, Wetlands Institute, International Water Management Institute, UN Environment World Conservation Monitoring Center via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
